_note: Summit books (guest books in a green mailbox beside every varde). Edit freely. varder: x,z = the varde, mx,mz,yaw = the mailbox beside it (door faces yaw, toward the nearest trail), model:true = the game adds a simple cairn there (no model existed). seed: older entries shown in each book (newest first is decided by the game from the order here: last = newest). Players sign with their login name, real local date and time, and the game day. reward = kr for the first signing of each book. presets = phrases for controller/mobile. Sharing: entries are saved per player locally; when the online relay is open they are also sent live to friends (type book).
presets: Saw something odd on the way up.
